question.worked_solution:
We proceed to factor the left-hand side by grouping:

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}^{3}-2{b}^{2}-6b+12 & = \\ ({b}^{3}-2{b}^{2})-(6b-12) & = \\ {b}^{2}(b-2)-6(b-2) & = \\ (b-2)\cdot {b}^{2}-(b-2)\cdot 6 & = \\ (b-2)({b}^{2}-6) & .\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve $(b-2)({b}^{2}-6)=0$ by setting each factor equal to $0.$

- Setting the factor $(b-2)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}b-2 & =0 \\ b & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

- Setting the factor $({b}^{2}-6)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}^{2}-6 & =0 \\ {b}^{2} & =6 \\ b & =\pm \sqrt{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $b=2,\,\pm \sqrt{6}.$
